summary: Frontend-only iteration 3 testing for Connect messaging app. All 12 requested features verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (375x667). Login → home with profile-button + 5-tab bottom nav (Home/Files/[+]/Calls/Spaces) → Spaces placeholder with waitlist → /you settings screen → /appearance theme/typography picker → theme persistence verified (Evening dark walnut palette stays across navigation back to /you and home) → quick-message modal sliding up with horizontal contact circles, selecting a contact + typing + tapping quick-send creates a chat and navigates to /chat/{id} → long-press on the center + reveals 4 radial action nodes → chat screen renders bubbles, voice messages, 'Start a shared space' pill, mic-button. No regression. No critical issues found.

issues: React Native Web console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow. Cosmetic only — does not affect rendering. Affects most StyleSheet entries that use shadowColor/shadowOpacity/etc.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate StyleSheet shadow* props to boxShadow to silence React Native Web 0.20+ deprecation warnings. Non-blocking.

(Known/accepted per request note) files.tsx and calls.tsx still import static `colors` from theme — they look correct in the default warm palette but will not follow the active theme when the user picks Evening/Charcoal. Consider switching them to useTheme() in a follow-up to avoid 'mixed mode' surfaces when a dark theme is active.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext fallback inside useTheme() is a nice safety net but masks bugs — fine for now.
new-message.tsx: when no users are loaded (empty list) the user is stuck with a disabled input and no empty-state message. Edge case only.
RadialMenu uses Modal with animationType='fade' inside a Pressable overlay — works on web but on iOS make sure the overlay catches taps outside nodes (it does via outer Pressable).
(tabs)/_layout.tsx Tabs component is wrapped with a custom tabBar — Tabs.Screen children for non-existing 'you' route are correctly omitted now.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST chat via the quick-message flow during testing (Ava → first contact, message 'test from playwright'). Persisted in DB but harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login submit button does NOT have a testID — use page.get_by_text('Sign in', exact=True).click(force=True). Email/password inputs are the first two <input> tags. After login the app lands on /(tabs)/index (URL '/'). Center FAB has testID 'quick-action-button'. Long-press = mouse.down() + 500ms wait + mouse.up() over the FAB triggers the radial menu (delayLongPress=220ms). Theme persistence is via AsyncStorage — a fresh playwright session starts on the default 'warm' theme. send-button only renders when the composer has text; mic-button is shown when empty (this is intentional, not a bug).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues to RCA this iteration.
